data.question_intent: Inquire about the bank's conservative approach to management overlays and future capital returns strategies.
data.question_quote: I guess one thing to me is why are you being so conservative, at least from external observers' point of view, with the £2bn of management overlays that you've got sitting in your provisions.
data.answer_quote: Why don't I take the first one and I'll ask Jes to talk about capital returns. The £2bn of management overlay, it's really there because, as you're aware, when we wrote these models, there was no concept of a pandemic as a scenario we could have modelled, no historical calibration that we could have used, and we don't think these models really can pick up the effect of government support, and more importantly the removal of government support schemes.
